answer: Interval fingerprinting: the ledger stores each identity's inter-answer rhythm, and an audit wanders that trellis of timestamps hunting clones paced like one machine - synchronized bursts after seed rotations, correlated idle gaps. Groups clustering tighter than independent hosts get jittered re-proofs; repeat clusters lose rewards. A farm rents wallets, not heartbeats: each clone still needs its own origin and its own tundra of wall-clock time, the one cost sybils cannot dodge.
